v_collectibles.editor.add_item_desc: Place an object with the cursor. Wheel = model, Shift + wheel = rotate, click = place, Ctrl + click = place more.
v_collectibles.editor.current_desc: Pick the list to edit or create a new one.
v_collectibles.editor.enabled_desc: Off = nobody sees this list (work in progress).
v_collectibles.editor.event_desc: Only visible while an events_core event switches it on (event config collectibles). Event now on: {state}
v_collectibles.editor.hint: COLLECTIBLE EDITOR - {name} ({count} items) - R: menu - F4: add item
v_collectibles.editor.hint_place: Model {model} ({name}) - rotation {rot}° - wheel: model - Shift + wheel: rotate - click: place - Ctrl + click: place more - right click: cancel
v_collectibles.editor.model_added: Model {model} added to the list header.
v_collectibles.editor.model_exists: Model {model} is already in the list.
v_collectibles.editor.models_desc: Header: the object models the items of this list may use.
v_collectibles.editor.new_list_desc: Name of the new list; the file name is made from it. New lists start disabled.
v_collectibles.editor.no_access: You have no access to the collectible editor.
v_collectibles.editor.no_models: Add a model to the list header first (R > Models).
v_collectibles.editor.opened: Editor on. R = menu, F4 = add item. /collecteditor again to quit.
v_collectibles.editor.pick_list_first: Pick or create a list first (R).
v_collectibles.editor.reward_desc: Money for every picked-up item of this list. Total = reward x {count} item(s) currently in the list. 0 = no reward.
v_collectibles.editor.reward_set: Reward set to {reward} per item - total {total} for {count} item(s).
v_collectibles.editor.title: Collectible editor
v_collectibles.editor.too_many_models: Too many models in this list.
